tools.name: get_eashl_club_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the current EASHL club leaderboard: the top-ranked clubs with their rank and points.

platform.description: EA platform slug. Defaults to common-gen5, which covers current-generation consoles and PC.

tools.name: open_chelhead_page
tools.description: Navigate this ChelHead tab to one of its pages, such as a club page, a player page, the club leaderboard or free agency.

path.description: Site-relative path to open, for example /clubs-top-leaderboard, /free-agency, or /view-club/common-gen5/12345.

tools.name: search_eashl_clubs
tools.description: Search EA NHL EASHL (World of Chel) clubs by name and return each match with its club id, so a club page can be opened or its stats read.

clubName.description: Full or partial EASHL club name to search for.

platform.description: EA platform slug. Defaults to common-gen5, which covers current-generation consoles and PC.

tools.name: search_eashl_players
tools.description: Search EA NHL EASHL players by gamertag and return each match with a link to their ChelHead stats page.

gamertag.description: Full or partial gamertag to search for.

platform.description: EA platform slug. Defaults to common-gen5, which covers current-generation consoles and PC.
